policy: English source definitions are the authority. Localized translations are only approved after qualified review; this glossary does not confer approval.

terms.meaning: A KingShot player character/persona associated with an account; not the account itself.
terms.policy: Use consistent game-specific terminology; do not interchange account and Governor.

terms.meaning: In-game organization to which Governors belong.
In-game kingdom/server context; can contain multiple Alliances.
terms.policy: Keep distinct from Alliance and real-world country.

terms.meaning: An administrator with effective Kingdom authority.
terms.policy: Retaining at least one administrator is mandatory when the source requires it.

terms.meaning: An obstacle preventing an operation from proceeding.
terms.policy: Do not translate as a converter, blocking software module, or a person who blocks.

terms.meaning: Operation cannot proceed under current conditions.
terms.policy: Distinguish from failed, pending, denied and cancelled.

terms.meaning: An attempted operation did not succeed.
terms.policy: Do not render as pending or completed.
Do not imply success when the source only states completion.

terms.meaning: Waiting for a future action or result.
terms.policy: Do not translate as completed or rejected.

terms.meaning: Inclusive maximum; the value must not be exceeded.
terms.policy: Never reverse to more than or at least; number grammar may differ by locale.

terms.meaning: Inclusive minimum; a smaller value is not permitted.
A prerequisite that must be satisfied.
An action that must not be performed.
Remove an association between an account and a Governor or identity.
terms.policy: Distinguish unlinking from deleting the underlying game identity.

terms.meaning: Remove the specified application record or resource.
terms.policy: Do not imply unlink-only when destructive action is intended.

terms.meaning: Whether a Governor or Kingdom satisfies applicable transfer conditions.
terms.policy: Do not equate eligibility with confirmed availability.

terms.meaning: Submitting an eligible Gift Code for an in-game reward.
terms.policy: Distinguish discovery, preparation, handoff, attempt and confirmed redemption.
